tasks.title: Set up project infrastructure (React, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, AWS S3)
Design and implement database schema for users, notes, groups, ratings, and notifications
Implement user registration and JWT authentication system
Build Home Dashboard screen with navigation, quick stats, and recent notes
Create UI component library (buttons, cards, inputs, avatars, badges) based on design system
Implement notes upload functionality with AWS S3 integration
Build Notes Browse screen with search, filter, and sort capabilities
Develop Note Detail screen with download, rating, and review features
Create Study Groups screen with create, join, and browse functionality
Build Group Detail screen with discussion, members, and resources tabs
Implement rating and review system for notes
Build Notifications screen with filtering and mark-as-read functionality
Implement notification system backend for new notes and group activities
Apply responsive design and accessibility standards across all screens
Conduct end-to-end testing and bug fixes for core user flows

risks: AWS S3 integration complexity may delay file upload/download features
Real-time notification system may require additional infrastructure setup
Database performance issues with large-scale note searches and filtering
User authentication security vulnerabilities if JWT implementation is not properly secured
Mobile responsiveness challenges across different device sizes and browsers
